ops.title: cookiesync install writes the persisted watch_debounce, defaulting to 10s
ops.description: install hardcodes watchDebounce = 3 * time.Second (internal/cli/install.go:24,58) into the synckit manifest, while cookie_sync.settings.watch_debounce is parsed and persisted (internal/state/settings.go:16,28,83,107) and never read by install. synckitd register replaces the registered manifest, so a re-install drops a live tuning (registered 10s on 2026-10-16; it survives ordinary synckit restarts). Make install write the operator's persisted setting and move its default to 10s, without activating services. Installed 0.31.2 (f6a8f12).

ops.text: install writes settings.watch_debounce into the manifest
doctor and install tests assert the setting-driven value; no service activation in tests
